Variants.Content: Entry The Grand Bachelor and the Chief of Intelligence represent the two needs of the royal power for knowledge and secrets respectively. The Grand Maester connects distant lands to the court through training in the Citadel, ravens, medicine, calendars, and archives; the Master of Intelligence relies on eyes and ears, merchant travelers, singers, servants, and the Unable to Write The former pursues verifiable letters, seals, and observations, while the latter often works on rumors, fears, and interests; both can be exploited, and both may become targets of power struggles. The specific holder and the authenticity of the message are variable, and the crown requires that the structure of the knowledge, communication and intelligence network remain unchanged.
